blocks.arabic_text: يُؤَمَّرُ عَلَي عَشَرَةٍ فَصَاعِدًا لَا يُقْسِطُ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيمَةِ فِي اْلاَصْفَادِ وَاْلاَغْلَالِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٤ /٨٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “If someone is appointed as amir over ten or more people, and he does not deal with them with justice and fairness, he will come on the Day of Qiyamah with shackles on his hands and on his neck,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ اِسْتَعْمَلَ بِشْرَ بْنَ عَاصِمٍ عَلَي صَدَقَاتِ هَوَازِنَ فَتَخَلَّفَ بِشْرٌ فَلَقِيَهُ عُمَرُ، فَقَالَ: مَا خَلَّفَكَ، أَمَا لَنَا عَلَيْكَ سَمْعٌ وَطَاعَةٌ، قَالَ: بَلي! وَلكِنْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ وُلِّيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ شَيْئاً أُتِيَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتّي يُوقَفَ عَلي جَسْرِ جَهَنَّمَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) اخرجه البخاري من طريق سويد، الاصابة:١٥٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Wa'il (RH) says, “Hazrat Umar (RA) appointed Hazrat Bishr ibn Asim (RA) to collect the sadaqah goods of the Hawazin tribe. But Hazrat Bishr (RA) did not go there. Hazrat Umar (RA) met him and asked him, “Why did you not go? Is obeying us not obligatory upon you?” “Why not? However, I have heard Rasulullah ﷺ say that if someone is made responsible for any task of the Muslims, on the Day of Qiyamah he will be brought and made to stand upon the bridge of Jahannam (if he fulfilled the responsibility properly he will escape, otherwise only the Fire of Jahannam awaits him)!” Hazrat Bishr (RA) replied.
